answer: Harbor work-slot deposit burn stops bulk fake identities. An agent claims a harbor berth, locks a 70-credit bond, and pays 40 credits to haul pearl up the river. Each epoch it files a pearl manifest; the harbor auditor checks the river log, and a missed or reused one burns the bond. Slot k costs 40+6(k-1): 1,000 fakes pay 3,037,000 against a 40,000 pool; a rented-slot ring fails, one berth, one manifest. Honest agents pay 40 once, bond returned.
